title: Weighing Dual Factors and Trade-Offs
goal: Balance paired arguments on remote work, pay and retention using no solo... sino (que) también and tanto... como.
grammar: correlative pairs no solo... sino (que) también and tanto... como

items: I can choose between *sino (también)* and *sino que (también)* depending on whether a second conjugated verb follows.
I can pair two equal workplace factors with *tanto … como* and plural verb agreement.
I can discuss remote work, hybrid models, pay, retention, performance and workload.
